visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and black sunglasses walks toward the camera in a selfie-perspective. She wears a dark olive green puffer jacket over a creamy white hoodie. The sun shines brightly from the upper left, creating a significant lens flare and warm lighting on her face. The background consists of a tall, dense green hedge on the left and a paved asphalt road on the right under a blue sky. (2) The scene cuts to a residential front yard where second-hand items are laid out on tables for an honesty sale. A white foldable table in the foreground holds various ceramic plates, teapots, and cups with blue and floral patterns. In the background, a vintage red convertible roadster is parked in a stone driveway next to a grey trash bin and green bushes. (3) The camera provides close-up views of items displayed on a black round table and inside a white wall-mounted cabinet attached to the green hedge. The cabinet contains small ceramic figurines and glass jars. A wooden board with a red ribbon displays handwritten prices and payment instructions. A metal clothing rack nearby is filled with various items like a grey utility vest and colorful garments on hangers. (4) The woman returns to the frame in a selfie-shot, gesturing with her right hand toward the sidewalk displays. She continues walking with a wide smile, her face brightly illuminated by the sun. Behind her, a traditional white house with a thatched roof is partially visible in the distance across the quiet street, surrounded by garden fences and mature trees. (5) A close-up shot focuses on a payment instruction sign placed on a table covered with a light blue patterned cloth. The sign includes a large QR code and lists MobilPay, PayPal, and Cash in mailbox as options. Several white ceramic cups and plates with yellow borders are arranged around the sign. The scene briefly cuts to a tan puffer jacket hanging on a silver rack in the garden area. (6) The final sequence shows detailed shots of vintage ceramic ware. A large white plate with a blue landscape illustration is highlighted, followed by smaller bowls containing dark blue berries and a brown ceramic jar. The items are set on a light-colored stone path. The woman's hand is partially visible while moving the camera as she examines the pieces.
